name: materials-section
title: Materials section
description: What it is made of and where it comes from: materials with share, origin and certification beside a short story, for products that must prove it.
docs: Pass a title, a story and materials (a name, a share in percent, an origin, an optional certification and a swatch, a CSS colour for the material's own tone), plus care, a short list for washing or maintenance. The share is written as text first and the thin bar under it is decoration, hidden from assistive technology. The shares should add up to 100: while you develop, the block warns in the console when they do not. Origins are plain places and a certification is a word in a badge. The halves sit side by side by the width of the block. The block has no state and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels, and the shares follow locale.
